I went through all of Moss's notes you have access to and found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at the Eau Claire yard (Dock Doors 14–18, 04:00 shift) weren't getting SMS bay assignments at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that it was fixed. The same note says to archive the kiosk logs before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
2. **#4419** is from *Moss: North cheat sheet* (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md, undated). Thea opened it because the gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 during third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.

Some things to watch for:
- Moss's Central handoff note also lists **#4409** and **#4412**, but both are on Pree's dealer account (Marrow Fieldworks), not QFL. Leave them out of the QFL deck.
- Moss's other two notes on QFL, from Sept 2025 and Mar 2026, mention it without giving any ticket numbers.
- **Quarendon Freightways** (one "r") is a different company and isn't a Pemberline customer, so don't mix them up.
- I only looked at notes you can see yourself. There may be other QFL tickets in places you can't see, such as the North team's channels. Dana Okafor owns the account and is the best person to confirm the list is complete.
